"""Expand existing validation reference contexts only; no sealed data or filter retuning."""
from datetime import datetime,timezone
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import numpy as np
from analysis.render import available_memory,runtime_env
from study_noise_neighbourhoods import ROOT,sha256,git


def run():
    started=datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    parent=ROOT/'docs/validation/raw/extraction-native-rafale-validation-bruit-v001-20261027T231306Z.json'
    source=json.loads(parent.read_text(encoding='utf-8'));digest=sha256(parent)
    p=Path(source['pixels']['path'])
    if sha256(p)!=source['pixels']['sha256']:raise ValueError('Changed baseline')
    with np.load(p,allow_pickle=False) as saved:baseline=saved['planes'].copy()
    tool=ROOT/'build-patch_noise/burst-tools/Release/iprBurstReference.exe';binary_hash=sha256(tool)
    folder=ROOT/'build-patch_noise/burst-reference512'/started.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ');folder.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
    records=[];pixels=[]
    for index,item in enumerate(source['records']):
        if (available_memory() or 0)<5*1024**3:raise ValueError('Need5GiB before RAW opening')
        raw=Path(item['path']);prefix=folder/raw.stem
        if sha256(raw)!=item['sha256']:raise ValueError('Changed RAW')
        subprocess.run([str(tool),str(prefix),str(raw)],env=runtime_env(tool),check=True,timeout=180)
        data=np.fromfile(prefix.with_suffix('.f32'),dtype='<f4').reshape(9,3,512,512)
        metadata=json.loads(prefix.with_suffix('.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        delta=float(np.max(abs(data[:,:,128:384,128:384]-baseline[index])))
        if not np.isfinite(data).all() or delta>2e-7 or metadata['sha256']!=item['sha256']:raise ValueError('Context centre differs from frozen baseline')
        pixels.append(data);records.append(dict(index=item['index'],path=str(raw),sha256=item['sha256'],native=metadata,
            baseline_max_abs_delta=delta,pixel_sha256=sha256(prefix.with_suffix('.f32'))))
        print('REFERENCE512',raw.name,index+1,'/14','delta',delta,flush=True)
    data=np.stack(pixels);archive=folder/'validation-reference-contexts.npz'
    with archive.open('xb') as handle:np.savez_compressed(handle,planes=data)
    if sha256(parent)!=digest or sha256(tool)!=binary_hash:raise ValueError('Changed dependencies')
    now=datetime.now(timezone.utc);output=ROOT/'docs/validation/raw'/f'contextes-reference-rafale-bruit-v001-{now.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")}.json'
    result=dict(schema_version=1,data_version=1,started_at_utc=started.isoformat(),completed_at_utc=now.isoformat(),
        parent=dict(path=str(parent),sha256=digest),records=records,
        tool=dict(path=str(tool),sha256=binary_hash),pixels=dict(path=str(archive),sha256=sha256(archive),shape=list(data.shape)),
        sources={str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):dict(sha256=sha256(p),source=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) for p in (ROOT/'tests/burst_tools/burst_controls.cpp',ROOT/'tests/burst_tools/CMakeLists.txt')},
        runner_sha256=sha256(Path(__file__)),runner_source=Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8'),commit=git('rev-parse','HEAD'),
        rules='Same14validationframesonly,512contextsaroundexisting256centres,nativepixelsnoresampling. Allcentral256comparedtoexistingnativebaseline2e-7. Geometrycorrectionforreferenceoverlap,notnewindependentstudy/newcandidate. Final14sealedremainunopened.',
        limitations='Samecamera/scene/ISO,globalregistrationnotcleantruth. Additionalcontextdoesnotcorrectparallax/blur/fixedpattern. No noiseprofileorfilterparameterchanges.',
        verdict='expanded_native_reference_context_geometry_only')
    with output.open('x',encoding='utf-8') as handle:json.dump(result,handle,ensure_ascii=False,indent=1,allow_nan=False)
    print('RESULT',output,flush=True)


if __name__=='__main__':run()
